ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the diagonals $AC$ and $BD$ of the rhombus $ABCD$ intersect at point $O$. $P$ is a moving point on side $AB$ (not coinciding with points $A$ or $B$). $PE \perp OA$ at point $E$, and $PF \perp OB$ at point $F$. If $AB=8$ and $\angle BAD=60^\circ$, what is the minimum length of segment $EF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution}: Connect OP, \\
$\because$ Quadrilateral ABCD is a rhombus, \\
$\therefore$ AC$\perp$BD, $\angle$CAB=$\frac{1}{2}\angle$DAB=$30^\circ$, \\
$\because$ PE$\perp$OA at point E, PF$\perp$OB at point F, \\
$\therefore$ $\angle$EOF=$\angle$OEP=$\angle$OFP=$90^\circ$, \\
$\therefore$ Quadrilateral OEPF is a rectangle, \\
$\therefore$ EF=OP, \\
$\because$ When OP takes the minimum value, the value of EF is also minimum, \\
$\therefore$ When OP$\perp$AB, OP is minimized, \\
$\because$ AB=8, \\
$\therefore$ OB=$\frac{1}{2}$AB=4, OA=$\sqrt{AB^2−OB^2}$=$4\sqrt{3}$, \\
$\therefore$ Area of $\triangle ABO$=$\frac{1}{2}$OA$\cdot$OB=$\frac{1}{2}$AB$\cdot$OP, \\
$\therefore$ OP=$\frac{4\times 4\sqrt{3}}{8}=\boxed{2\sqrt{3}}$, \\
$\therefore$ The minimum value of EF is $2\sqrt{3}$.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as a rhombus with diagonals AC and BD intersecting at O, P on side AB, E on OA with PE perpendicular OA, and F on OB with PF perpendicular OB. From the text use AB=8 and angle BAD=60°. Use rhombus facts: diagonals are perpendicular and diagonal AC bisects angle BAD, so angle OAB=30° and triangle AOB is right at O. Thus OB=AB/2=4 and OA=4√3. Since OE lies on OA and OF lies on OB, and PE and PF are perpendicular to those axes, OEPF is a rectangle, so EF=OP. The minimum EF is therefore the shortest distance from O to line AB, i.e. the altitude of right triangle AOB to hypotenuse AB. Compute it by area: (1/2)OA·OB=(1/2)AB·OP, giving OP=(4√3·4)/8=2√3.

再推理：菱形的对角线互相垂直，并且对角线AC平分∠BAD，所以∠OAB=∠CAB=30°，△AOB在O处为直角三角形。已知AB=8，因此在直角三角形AOB中，OB=AB·sin30°=4，OA=AB·cos30°=4√3。

因为OE在OA上，OF在OB上，且OA⊥OB；又PE⊥OA，所以PE∥OB；PF⊥OB，所以PF∥OA。因此四边形OEPF是矩形，矩形的对角线相等，所以EF=OP。

要使EF最小，只需使OP最小。P在AB上运动时，OP的最小值就是点O到直线AB的垂直距离，即△AOB斜边AB上的高。由面积相等：
(1/2)·OA·OB=(1/2)·AB·OP，
所以OP=(OA·OB)/AB=(4√3×4)/8=2√3。

因此EF的最小值为2√3。

method.method_draft: Read the figure as triangle AOB cut out from the rhombus, with OA and OB perpendicular diagonals and P varying on segment AB; E and F are the perpendicular projections of P onto OA and OB respectively. Since AC bisects angle BAD, angle OAB=30°, so in right triangle AOB, OB=4 and OA=4√3. Set A=(4√3,0), B=(0,4). A point P=(x,y) on AB satisfies x/(4√3)+y/4=1. Because E=(x,0) and F=(0,y), EF=sqrt(x^2+y^2). raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, the diagonals $AC$ and $BD$ of the rhombus $ABCD$ intersect at point $O$. $P$ is a moving point on side $AB$ (not coinciding with $A$ or $B$). $PE \perp OA$ at point $E$, and $PF \perp OB$ at point $F$. If $AB=8$ and $\angle BAD=60^\circ$, what is the minimum length of segment $EF$?
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution}: Connect $OP$. \\
$\because$ quadrilateral $ABCD$ is a rhombus, \\
$\therefore$ $AC\perp BD$, and $\angle CAB=\frac{1}{2}\angle DAB=30^\circ$. \\
$\because$ $PE\perp OA$ at $E$, and $PF\perp OB$ at $F$, \\
$\therefore$ $\angle EOF=\angle OEP=\angle OFP=90^\circ$. \\
$\therefore$ quadrilateral $OEPF$ is a rectangle, so $EF=OP$. \\
$\because$ when $OP$ takes the minimum value, $EF$ also takes the minimum value, \\
$\therefore$ when $OP\perp AB$, $OP$ is minimized. \\
$\because$ $AB=8$, \\
$\therefore$ $OB=\frac{1}{2}AB=4$, and $OA=\sqrt{AB^2-OB^2}=4\sqrt{3}$. \\
$\therefore$ Area of $\triangle ABO=\frac{1}{2}OA\cdot OB=\frac{1}{2}AB\cdot OP$. \\
$\therefore$ $OP=\frac{4\times 4\sqrt{3}}{8}=\boxed{2\sqrt{3}}$. \\
$\therefore$ the minimum value of $EF$ is $2\sqrt{3}$.
raw_record.final_cot:
First describe the image: In the figure is rhombus ABCD, A is at the lower left, B is at the lower right, C is at the upper right, D is at the upper left; diagonals AC and BD intersect at O. Point P is on side AB, E is on OA and PE is perpendicular to OA, F is on OB and PF is perpendicular to OB.

Then reason: The diagonals of a rhombus are perpendicular to each other, and diagonal AC bisects ∠BAD, so ∠OAB=∠CAB=30°, and △AOB is a right triangle at O. Given AB=8, therefore in right triangle AOB, OB=AB·sin30°=4, OA=AB·cos30°=4√3.

Because OE is on OA, OF is on OB, and OA⊥OB; also PE⊥OA, so PE∥OB; PF⊥OB, so PF∥OA. Therefore quadrilateral OEPF is a rectangle, and the diagonals of a rectangle are equal, so EF=OP.

To make EF minimum, it is only necessary to make OP minimum. When P moves on AB, the minimum value of OP is the perpendicular distance from point O to line AB, that is, the altitude to hypotenuse AB of △AOB. From equal areas:
(1/2)·OA·OB=(1/2)·AB·OP,
so OP=(OA·OB)/AB=(4√3×4)/8=2√3.

Therefore the minimum value of EF is 2√3.
